collection.title: Škoda Enyaq 2020 to 2025 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Skoda Enyaq 2020 - 2025 model requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Slim Push Button arm attachment.
